description: List the tools this server exposes and what each one charges for, what the corpus is, the closed vocabularies their filters accept — countries, site types, niche levels (cohort_levels; level 1 holds the narrowest niches and each higher level groups the niches of the level below), index axes, banding schemes with their numeric boundaries — the per-call limits in force for your organization, its plan and the free quota the plan includes, and the disclosure rules that govern what is returned before and after a project is revealed. Free. Call it once at the start of a session instead of guessing filter values: unknown values are rejected, not ignored. Its vocabularies and prices are the same from call to call; the plan, quota and limits it reports follow your organization, so read it again after your user registers; what your organization has left to spend is in usage.
name: capabilities
title: Service capabilities and filter values
